posts.name: Spiff
posts.cooked: This may be completely unhelpful, but did you know that in Photoshop, if you have a black and white line drawing on one layer, then you make another layer for the color but change that layer's type to be "multiply", you can color all the way up to the black lines and even on top of them, and it won't actually color over the black lines?  It makes coloring in black and white drawings like that super easy and pleasant.  I only mention it because of the uncolored spots in the drawing, and I didn't know if you were using this technique.
